name: memoryai-monorepo
description: MemoryAI: Open-source, local-first long-term memory platform for AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sachin97317/types && npm run build -w @sachin97317/security && npm run build -w @sachin97317/observability && npm run build -w @sachin97317/embeddings && npm run build -w @sachin97317/reranking && npm run build -w @sachin97317/context-builder && npm run build -w @sachin97317/extraction && npm run build -w @sachin97317/memory-engine && npm run build -w @sachin97317/consolidation && npm run build -w @sachin97317/storage-sqlite && npm run build -w @sachin97317/storage-memory-format && npm run build -w @sachin97317/core && npm run build -w @sachin97317/sdk && npm run build -w @sachin97317/mcp && npm run build -w @sachin97317/adapter-chatgpt && npm run build -w @sachin97317/adapter-claude && npm run build -w @sachin97317/adapter-gemini && npm run build -w @sachin97317/adapter-cursor && npm run build -w @sachin97317/adapter-codex && npm run build -w @sachin97317/api && npm run build -w memoryai
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/memory/*.test.mjs tests/retrieval/*.test.mjs tests/mcp/*.test.mjs tests/security/isolation.test.mjs tests/security/injection-hardening.test.mjs tests/security/ssrf-limits.test.mjs tests/providers/*.test.mjs tests/skills/*.test.mjs tests/import-export/*.test.mjs tests/embeddings/*.test.mjs tests/concurrency/*.test.mjs tests/reliability/*.test.mjs tests/migration/*.test.mjs tests/cli/*.test.mjs tests/dashboard/*.test.mjs tests/performance/*.test.mjs tests/regression/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/*.test.mjs
scripts.publish:dry: npm publish -w @sachin97317/types --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/security --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/observability --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/embeddings --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/reranking --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/context-builder --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/extraction --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/memory-engine --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/consolidation --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/storage-sqlite --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/storage-memory-format --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/core --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/sdk --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/mcp --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-chatgpt --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-claude --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-gemini --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-cursor --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-codex --dry-run && npm publish -w @sachin97317/api --dry-run && npm publish -w memoryai --dry-run
scripts.publish:all: npm publish -w @sachin97317/types --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/security --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/observability --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/embeddings --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/reranking --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/context-builder --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/extraction --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/memory-engine --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/consolidation --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/storage-sqlite --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/storage-memory-format --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/core --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/sdk --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/mcp --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-chatgpt --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-claude --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-gemini --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-cursor --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/adapter-codex --access public && npm publish -w @sachin97317/api --access public && npm publish -w memoryai --access public
